about: Who owns and works at an outlet (OPUS-PEOPLE press): its owner, who holds it and is paid by none; its head, who sets the editorial line; and its reporters. Titles are the Standard Occupational Classification's names; ages and pay are rows in parameters.json.
source: BLS Standard Occupational Classification 2018: 11-1011 Chief Executives; 27-3041 Editors; 27-3023 News Analysts, Reporters, and Journalists.
